Alternative engine oils with the viscosity SAE 5W-30 meeting the requirements of Ford Specification WSS-M2C913-B may also be used. CI-G9-9HU-JUMPY_HDI-X.notes: BORROWED from Fiat Scudo G9 handbook (Fiat twin of Jumpy II/Expert II/ProAce I, same PSA engine code printed in the book).
